object_description: four-building station and residential ensemble under a cantilevered roof
design_condition: Four structures extend from Zürcherstrasse to the railway tracks, with three joined by a cantilevered roof and a fourth standing detached to the northeast.

positive.statement: The building volume is distributed over four structures to respect the surrounding grain and ensure permeability.
The cantilevered roof provides weather protection for bus and train passengers.
The apartments are clearly zoned and easy to furnish, with mostly two-sided orientation.
The situation in front of the city center is clarified.
Pedestrians are guided under the arcades without traffic.

negative.statement: The retail areas and vertical access create a hidden back area that does not provide easily manageable spaces.
The different entrance positions for the two underpasses do not contribute to easy orientation.
The minimum bus-platform widths cannot be adhered to.
The underground-car-park entrance creates a potential conflict between different users.
The fourth building obscures the legibility of the overall development idea.
The quality of the open ground-floor space is not convincing.
The development primarily conveys an image of residential buildings and is not convincing as a station plaza.
The massive-looking bodies show the largest volume of all contributions.
